claim: Patchline ships a sensitivity-to-confounding bound (E-value) for every causal claim in the paper. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the E-value claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make evalue-confounding-bound-gate`.
